class.name: Lobbies
class.brief_description: Playing together through Godot's high-level multiplayer, on any platform.
class.description: A lobby sets the scene tree's multiplayer peer, so the game plays through Godot's high-level multiplayer ([MultiplayerAPI], RPCs, [MultiplayerSynchronizer]) as usual. When the online service is set up ([code]online/url[/code]) and the player is signed in to it, lobbies are crossplay: players on any platform join with a code and play peer to peer over WebRTC, through a TURN relay when they can't connect directly. Otherwise they're the platform's own, for players on that platform: Steam lobbies, or Game Center matches on Apple platforms. Everything else works the same in those, decided by the players' games together instead of by the service. [codeblock] var result = await Lobbies.create() code_label.text = result.code # the others enter it in Lobbies.join() [/codeblock] Ranked modes find players of a similar rating ([method matchmake]), and the others keep play fair: [method check] catches a game that disagrees with everyone else's, [method flag] lets the players' games report what they saw, and players can [method report] and [method block] each other.

method.name: block
method.description: Blocks the player with this peer ID in the current lobby: they won't be matched with this player again or let into lobbies this player hosts. Without the online service, blocks are kept in the player's saves.

method.name: can_invite
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method invite_friends] has a platform screen to open here.

method.name: can_matchmake
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method matchmake] works here: with the online service, on Steam, or on Game Center.

method.name: cancel_matchmaking
method.description: Stops waiting for a match. The [method matchmake] call completes with [code]error[/code] [code]"cancelled"[/code].

method.name: check
method.description: Compares [param value] with what the other players in the lobby send for the same [param name], to catch players whose game disagrees with everyone else's. Every player's game calls it at the same moment in the game (the end of a lap, the end of a round) with something they can all work out: a time, a score, a hash of the shared state. Only a hash of [param value] leaves the device. Each name is checked once per lobby. [signal check_completed] gives the outcome.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a lobby the player hosts (as peer 1), and sets the scene tree's multiplayer peer. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and the lobby's [code]code[/code], which other players enter in [method join]. With [code]lobbies/relay_only[/code] on, crossplay lobbies connect only through TURN, so players never see each other's IP address.

method.name: flag
method.description: Tells the lobby this player's game saw the player with [param peer_id] do something the game doesn't allow, such as moving faster than possible. [param reason] is a short name of your choosing (letters, digits, [code]_[/code], [code].[/code], [code]:[/code] and [code]-[/code]), like [code]"teleport"[/code]. When more than half of the other players, and at least two, flag the same player for the same reason within 10 seconds, [signal player_flagged] fires on everyone's device. One player can't get another flagged alone, so a lobby of two never confirms a flag.

method.name: get_rating
method.description: The player's rating in a ranked mode. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and [code]data[/code] with [code]rating[/code] (1000 to start) and [code]matches[/code]. Without the online service, the rating is kept in the player's saves.

method.name: has_crossplay
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if lobbies are crossplay here: the online service is set up and answered.

method.name: invite_friends
method.description: Opens the platform's invite screen for the current lobby: Steam's, or Game Center's. A friend accepting it joins the lobby, starting the game first if needed, and [signal joined] fires on their side. Elsewhere, players share the lobby's code.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if lobbies work here: the online service answered, Steam is running, or the player is signed in to Game Center.

method.name: join
method.description: Joins the lobby with this code, and sets the scene tree's multiplayer peer. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code].

method.name: kick
method.description: For the host of a lobby: removes the player with this peer ID. They get [signal kicked] and can't come back to this lobby.

method.name: leave
method.description: Leaves the lobby and clears the scene tree's multiplayer peer. A [method create], [method join] or [method matchmake] still waiting completes with [code]error[/code] [code]"cancelled"[/code], as it does when the game asks for another lobby first.

method.name: matchmake
method.description: Finds [param players] players (2 to 8) of a similar rating for the ranked [param mode] (a name of your choosing, like [code]"duel"[/code]) and joins them in a new lobby: a crossplay one hosted by whoever waited longest, or, without the online service, a Steam lobby hosted by its owner or a Game Center match hosted by the player with the lowest Game Center ID. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and the lobby's [code]code[/code], as with [method join]. The wait widens the rating range over time, and never matches players who blocked each other.

method.name: report
method.description: Reports the player with this peer ID in the current lobby to the service's operator. [param details] is up to 500 characters of the player's own words. In a Steam lobby, it opens the player's Steam profile instead, where Steam's own report button is; Game Center has no way to report players, so there it does nothing.

method.name: report_result
method.description: In a lobby from [method matchmake]: who finished where, as this player's game saw it, as an [Array] of every player's peer ID from first to last (the host is [code]1[/code]). Every player's game should report it. Ratings change once enough players report the same result (more than half by default, set per game on the service; more than half without it), so no single player can change them alone; [signal result_recorded] fires then. A lobby's result counts once.

signal.name: check_completed
signal.description: Emitted when every player in the lobby has answered the check [param name]. [param agreed] is [code]true[/code] if everyone sent the same value. [param disagreeing] has the peer IDs of players who differ from the majority, who the service reports as cheating unless the game turned that off, and removes from the lobby if the game has [code]kick_cheaters[/code] on; it's empty when there's no majority. In a ranked lobby, a failed check stops the result from counting.

signal.name: host_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the host left the lobby and, with [code]lobbies/host_migration[/code] on, another player took over: in a crossplay lobby, the player who'd been there longest; in a Steam lobby, the one Steam made its owner; in a Game Center match, the one with the lowest Game Center ID. The new host is peer 1, and [param is_host] is [code]true[/code] on their device. Everyone reconnects to them; the game moves on from where it was.

signal.name: joined
signal.description: Emitted when the player joined a lobby, including from a friend's invite or a Game Center party.

signal.name: kicked
signal.description: Emitted when the host removed this player from the lobby. The multiplayer peer is gone.

signal.name: player_flagged
signal.description: Emitted when most of the other players flagged the player with [param peer_id] for [param reason] (see [method flag]). The service reports them as cheating unless the game turned that off, removes them from the lobby if the game has [code]kick_cheaters[/code] on, and in a ranked lobby the result no longer counts.

signal.name: result_recorded
signal.description: Emitted when a matchmade lobby's result has been recorded and the players' ratings changed: by the service, or, without it, by this player's game in their saves.

constants.constant: Anything else, explained in the details.
